notes: Names printed: MARSHALL AV. (40' north of Riddle, 50' south of it), RIDDLE R'D (60'), PROBASCO (NOT IMPROVED) 50'. Riddle Road and Probasco both run off the right edge with no other cross streets on this sheet.
